Requirements You’re wearing or holding a Repair or Artisan’s Toolkit, and have a free hand to use them.

You improve the quality of potential cover or quickly create one yourself. You use Fortify on an adjacent surface or object a creature can use as cover. The DC of this check is 20, though circumstances such as the surface’s material and availability of tools to create cover may adjust it higher or lower. This cover must be a physical, tangible surface or object, and cannot be a magical conjured surface or wall unless you have Magical Crafting.

If you successfully Fortify the cover, you create lesser cover if there is none, or treat the cover you fortify as one step of cover as higher (so standard Cover becomes greater Cover). You can then choose to Take Cover. The improvements last for 1 minute, but you can take 1 minute to perform this action to lengthen the duration to 10 minute. Only one creature can Take Cover in the fortified area at a time.
